metric.normalization: whole-note RMS 0.1, no frame normalization or time warp
metric.loss: 0.5 attack L1 + 0.5 sustain L1, mean of resolutions

temporal_metric.empty_phases: omit and renormalize; no artificial excerpt release
temporal_metric.short_loss: equal-weight first 150 ms attack and remainder

evaluation_policy.pitch_expression_guides: identical supplied guides, no validation parameter fitting
evaluation_policy.automatic_bow: unweighted paired notes, no recorded expression on either side
